brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build provides a shelf surface as cover:0,0,0;full;top on piece:0,0,0;full (80mm thick hex base). Joint bolts jointBolt:0#0,-1#5 and jointBolt:0#0,0#5 lock the three-piece cluster (0,-1 half-s + 0,0 full + 0,1 half-n) and meshClash is clear. However the Hex Cluster configurator only verifies geometric fit and mesh clearance (check_build reports no load/strength data) and the instructions prohibit claiming load ratings — no part is catalogued with a 50kg rating and check_build does not validate strength, so a certified 50kg rating cannot be verified in this system.
Two drawers installed: drawer:0#0,-1#cut on half-s base at 0,-1,0 (slot n) and drawer:0#0,1#cut on half-n base at 0,1,0 (slot s), each on its half-base cut face as offered by find_sockets.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell linear shelf unit (half-s + full + half-n) with joint bolts locking the cluster and a full top cover as the shelf surface. Two drawers are installed on the end half-bases. Geometry verifies clear, but 50 kg load rating is not verifiable in the configurator which only checks fit/mesh, not structural load capacity.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: L bracket
parts.use: Back plate on the flat, shelf on top, gusset underneath: the part to bolt on when something has to stick out sideways and stay level.

parts.name: Side connector, single
parts.use: Bridges the seam between two neighbouring cells and resists shear across it, for a cluster that gets pushed sideways rather than only loaded down.

parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
